## Teaching points

1. Marked symptomatic hypercalcemia warrants monitored treatment. Review calcium and alkali intake and evaluate the underlying cause.
2. Stop excess calcium/alkali, restore volume with reassessment and investigate the cause, including PTH-directed evaluation.
3. The catalog lacks calcium-lowering specialist drugs and PTH measurement. Handoff must address these; serum calcium is not scripted to normalize simply with time.
